events.label: College designation under provincial law
events.note: Order in Council 2960/1978 was approved November 24 and took effect December 1 under the Colleges and Provincial Institutes Act, section 6(1). This is distinct from the college’s 1969 opening and 1971 vocational school amalgamation.

events.label: Statutory designation takes effect
events.note: A separate event from the 1975 opening.

events.label: College region extended
events.note: Adds a specified part of Creston-Kaslo.

events.label: Renamed College of the Rockies
events.note: The signed order and audited statements support November, not May as on the public history page. This was a rename, not a merger.

events.label: East Kootenay Community College renamed College of the Rockies
Amalgamated with BCIT
events.note: Section 2 continues both institutes as one corporation. Section 3 concerns their student societies separately.

sharedIdentities.label: UBC Visual Identity Rules
sharedIdentities.note: UBC Okanagan uses UBC’s crest in its official campus signature. The campus wording does not establish a separate institution or inherit Okanagan University College’s artwork.
